# Engine question types (generated by tools/gen_engine_questions.py, do not edit by hand)

Every question type below is answered from geometry or a trained detector, with evidence. `query(path, intent, category, scope)` builds the canonical question; `answer(path, any_question)` also accepts free-form questions in en/zh/fi/sv/de/fr/it via `engine/nlq.py` and returns `method: unrecognised_question` instead of guessing.

## swiss_dwellings (vector plans, one storey)

| intent | category | scope | canonical question |
|---|---|---|---|
| count | door | whole floor | How many doors (interior doors and entrance doors together) are drawn on this floor plan? |
| count | window | whole floor | How many windows are drawn on this floor plan? |
| count | toilet | whole floor | How many toilets (WC) are drawn on this floor plan? |
| count | sink | whole floor | How many washbasins are drawn on this floor plan? |
| count | bathtub | whole floor | How many bathtubs are drawn on this floor plan? |
| count | shower | whole floor | How many showers are drawn on this floor plan? |
| count | apartment | whole floor | How many apartments (residential units) are shown on this floor plan? |
| count | room | {label} | How many rooms labelled '<label>' are there on this floor? |
| area | — | {room: number} | What is the net floor area of room <number> ('<label>') in m²? |
| area | — | {apartment: letter} | What is the net floor area of apartment <A> in m², summing all its rooms except balconies, loggias, terraces and other outdoor spaces? |
| area | — | {label} | What is the total net area in m² of all rooms labelled '<label>' on this floor? |
| area | — | whole floor | What is the total net floor area in m² of all numbered indoor rooms on this floor (excluding balconies, loggias, terraces and other outdoor spaces, shafts and voids)? |

## cubicasa5k (raster plans, counts only)

| category | canonical question |
|---|---|
| door | How many doors are shown on this floor plan? Count doorways fitted with a door; open doorways without a door leaf do not count. |
| window | How many windows are shown on this floor plan? |
| toilet | How many toilet bowls (WC seats) are drawn on this floor plan? |
| sink | How many sinks and wash basins (kitchen and bathroom combined; a double-bowl sink counts as one) are drawn on this floor plan? |
| shower_tub | How many showers and bathtubs are drawn on this floor plan in total? |
| storey | How many floors (storeys) does this floor plan show? |
| sauna | How many saunas are on this floor plan? |
| kitchen | How many kitchens (including kitchenettes, open kitchens and utility kitchens) are on this floor plan? |
| bedroom | How many bedrooms (makuuhuone, usually marked MH) are on this floor plan? |
| bathroom | How many bathrooms or washrooms (e.g. KH, KPH, PH, PESUH, SH) are on this floor plan, not counting separate WC rooms? |
| wc_room | How many separate WC rooms (toilet rooms marked WC) are on this floor plan? |
| balcony | How many balconies (parveke, including glazed balconies) are on this floor plan? |

Room types on Swiss plans map to the labels written in the drawing: kitchen → küche, cuisine, cucina, kochen, küche/essen, wohnküche; bathroom → bad, bain, bagno, dusche, douche, doccia, bad/wc, salle de bain; bedroom → schlafzimmer, chambre, camera; balcony → balkon, balcon, balcone, loggia, terrasse, terrazza; wc_room → wc, toilette; stair → treppenhaus, cage d'escalier, vano scala, treppe

## definitions

- **door**: doorways fitted with a door leaf; open doorways without a leaf are not counted
- **sink**: kitchen and bathroom sinks/wash basins; a double-bowl sink counts as one
- **area**: net floor area in m² (inside the walls)
- **apartment_area**: net area of all rooms of the apartment except balconies, loggias, terraces and other outdoor spaces
